title: The work, cut together
description: A magenta and citron portfolio zine: cut-out lettering, public app imagery and two crossing streams of project names.
signature: Counter-moving project-name bands cross a collage of Viva Fresh store frames; one pause control stills the whole cover.
holdback: Mobile introduces the product imagery relatively late, and the bands obscure some of it; the direct Viva Fresh link preserves access.
